title: Checking Tokens with tiktoken
description: A short cell that encodes five words with the cl100k_base tokenizer and prints each word's token count and pieces, to compare against the hand trace.

steps.description: This cell uses `tiktoken`. The comment names the install command, and the code loads the `cl100k_base` encoding into `enc`. The warning above notes this runs in your course container, not in the page.
The loop walks five words, including `lowest` from the hand trace and `strawberry`.
`enc.encode` turns each word into token IDs, and `enc.decode` turns each ID back into its text piece.
The print line shows the word, its token count, and the pieces it split into.

steps.question: The page says the split points land mid-morpheme because the tokenizer optimizes for what, rather than meaning?
